description.en: Sordes pilosus inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Nominal overall 1m art envelope, not fossil measurement. PIN2585/3 Fig3F and4F Elgin etal2011 anchor limb and ankle membrane relation. NaishMartill2003 small whole image for gross layout only. Kellner2009 personally examined Sordes pycnofibres around body femur tibia distinct from membrane actinofibrils. Dense low root fringe stylized. Membrane edge, density, tail tip, colors and pose artistic. No Jeholopterus image or model reuse.

scientific_scope.intentional_overlap: Closed body, neck, tail and limb roots deliberately overlap internally at anatomical joints; closed membrane edges coincide with supporting arms and legs. Dense small tapered tufts intentionally overlap trunk and proximal membranes. No watertight union claim; two wing forelimbs and two hindlimbs.
